scope.description: Three real OmniPaxos instances with pids 1, 2 and 5 in one ClusterConfig, MemoryStorage, batch_size 1. The cluster decides three entries, then the leader calls trim(Some(2)) and trim(None) and the probe records the outcome, the reported minimum in the error, and the compacted index afterwards.
assumptions: All produced messages are delivered to their addressed node until none remain.
No ticks are called; leadership is obtained with try_become_leader.
excluded: Snapshots, batching, flexible quorums, reconfiguration and crash recovery.

basis.prefix: Build pids 1, 2 and 5 with ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2,5]} and settle. node1.try_become_leader(); settle. Append Value(1..=3) with a full settle after each. Emit setup with decided and all_accepted_min (minimum get_accepted_idx over the three configured nodes). Call trim(Some(2)) and record trim_ok, error_min (NotAllDecided value) and compacted_after_some; call trim(None) and record none_ok and compacted_after_none. Emit trim_result with requested, all_accepted_min, decided and those fields.

comparisons.description: Trim of an index accepted by every configured node should succeed; the predicate is expected to be violated if the sparse-pid placeholders pin the minimum to 0.
